intro: Luxembourg is a small, landlocked country of forested hills, river valleys and vineyards.

chapters.title: Two regions
text: The hilly, wooded north, the Oesling, is part of the Ardennes; the south, the Gutland ('good land'), is gentler farmland. Vineyards line the Moselle valley on the German border.
Luxembourg borders Belgium, France and Germany. The capital is built on cliffs above two rivers, with tunnels called casemates carved into the rock.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Luxembourg has a mild climate with cool, wet winters and warm summers.
